Leah (support): Hey team — enterprise customer acct_9XK4 reports a sudden spike in 429s + high p95 latency against /v1/chat/completions starting ~2026-03-17T09:10Z. They pasted a couple of failed request_ids: req_20260317_9ab1, req_20260317_9ab2. Can SRE help attribute this to quota enforcement vs infra saturation?

Ravi (sre): On it. Can you drop tenant id and a sample request payload or timestamp window? Any recent quota changes for them?

Leah (support): Tenant: acct_9XK4. No recent plan changes; they say volume increased from background jobs. Sample log snippet they gave: `{"ts":"2026-03-17T09:11:02Z","req_id":"req_20260317_9ab1","status":429,"route":"/v1/chat/completions","model":"rwd/gpt-13b-q8"}`

Tom (infra): Pulling ingress & svc metrics now. Quick promQL I ran: `sum by (route, model, tenant) (increase(http_responses_total{code=\"429\"}[5m]))` — showing 86 429s for route=/v1/chat/completions, model=rwd/gpt-13b-q8, tenant=acct_9XK4 between 09:10-09:15. CPU on the pool holding that model stayed ~55%. Not purely node OOM.

Ravi (sre): Also check quota enforcement counters: `increase(rate_limit_enforced_total{tenant=\"acct_9XK4\"}[10m])` and `increase(quota_exhausted_total{tenant=\"acct_9XK4\"}[10m])`. Ran both: rate_limit_enforced_total=72, quota_exhausted_total=4 — suggests enforcement (limits) mainly.

ObservabilityBot: :warning: Alert fired — High 429s for route /v1/chat/completions (tenant: acct_9XK4). Threshold=50 429s / 5m. Fired at 2026-03-17T09:12Z. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/limits/tenant-playback?var-tenant=acct_9XK4

Jing (product): Good context. Can we confirm whether those 429s came from token-rate enforcement, concurrent request limit, or a custom per-route throttle? Need attribution so we can advise the customer (increase burst vs change client retry).

Tom (infra): I correlated `429` labels with `rl_type` label: breakdown shows `rl_type=\"token_rate\"` 64 hits, `rl_type=\"concurrency\"` 8, `rl_type=\"route_policy\"` 4. So token rate is dominant. Query used: `sum by (rl_type) (increase(rate_limit_enforced_total{tenant=\"acct_9XK4\",route=\"/v1/chat/completions\"}[5m]))`.

Leah (support): Customer says their background jobs launched a fanout and they didn't smooth requests. They're asking for a short-term workaround (we can escalate to increase quota?) and long-term advice (backoff + retries).

Ravi (sre): Short-term options: 1) temporary burst increase for tenant (admin override), 2) route fallback to a smaller model (less unit token cost), 3) enable per-tenant queueing to smooth spikes. Example admin override API (internal):

```
POST /internal/admin/tenants/acct_9XK4/overrides
{
  "burst_tokens": 200000,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-17T12:00:00Z",
  "reason": "support: spike mitigation"
}
```

Tom (infra): I can apply a small temporary burst override if we want to bring them back up quickly. I'd rather also add an alert panel tying 429 spikes to token_rate enforcement and to model selection so it's easier next time.

Jing (product): For the dashboard panel suggestion — propose a three-column panel: 1) 429 count by rl_type, 2) token consumption (tokens/sec) by tenant, 3) model selection per request (count). Example promQL for correlation: `sum by (tenant, model) (increase(tokens_consumed_total[5m]))` and `sum by (tenant, rl_type) (increase(rate_limit_enforced_total[5m]))`. Bonus: show `queue_length` and `svc_latency_p95` as overlays.

Leah (support): Customer provided repro steps — they run ~1200 small chat requests in parallel for a sync job. Repro curl they shared: 

```
for i in {1..1200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
    -d '{"model":"rwd/gpt-13b-q8","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}]}' &
done
wait
```

Ravi (sre): That explains token_rate enforcement. Recommend: advise customer to add client-side concurrency cap and exponential backoff. Also: support team should edit runbook to include the PromQL snippets and the admin override procedure.

Tom (infra): I'll create a Grafana panel and short alert rule: fire when `sum(increase(rate_limit_enforced_total{route=\"/v1/chat/completions\"}[5m])) by (tenant) > 50` and link to playbook. I'll also tag affected model pools for autoscale review.

Leah (support): I'll apply the temporary override now and notify customer. Will follow up with a support ticket with recommended client changes and a pointer to the new dashboard.

Jing (product): Can we add a column to the tenant overview in Console showing "recent limit hits" (count in last 24h) so support + sales can see exposure at a glance? If so, file a small feature request.

Leah (support): Filing FR: FR-5143 for Console tenant overview "recent limit hits".

Ravi (sre): Applied burst override (200k tokens until 12:00Z). Observability shows 429s dropping immediately. Keep monitoring for retries that could create secondary pressure.

Leah (support): Customer confirmed service restored, will implement client-side caps. Updating runbook and closing once FR + dashboard done. :white_check_mark:
